scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:ui" "npm run dev:desktop"
scripts.dev:desktop: wait-on http://localhost:4200 && UI_DEV_URL=http://localhost:4200 API_DEV=1 npm -w apps/desktop run dev
scripts.build: npm -w apps/api run build && npm -w apps/ui run build && npm -w apps/desktop run build
scripts.start:desktop: npm run build && npm -w apps/desktop run start
scripts.package:desktop: npm -w apps/api run prisma:generate && npm run build && npm -w apps/desktop run package:linux
